description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for configuration commands in the Mattermost CLI, including reset, patch, get, set, edit, show, reload, export, and migrate commands, with permission checks and file handling.

methods.name: TestConfigResetCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests the configuration reset command for admin and permission scenarios.

methods.name: TestConfigPatchCmd
methods.description: Tests the patching of configuration via files, including permission checks and invalid file handling.

methods.name: TestConfigGetCmdF
methods.description: Tests retrieving configuration values by key, including error handling and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestConfigSetCmd
methods.description: Tests setting configuration values by key, including permission restrictions and special cases like import directory.

methods.name: TestConfigEditCmd
methods.description: Tests editing configuration via an external editor script, including permission checks.

methods.name: TestConfigShowCmdF
methods.description: Tests displaying server configuration with permission checks.

methods.name: TestConfigReloadCmdF
methods.description: Tests reloading server configuration with permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestConfigExportCmdF
methods.description: Tests exporting configuration, including masking, default removal, and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestConfigMigrateCmdF
methods.description: Tests migrating configuration between file and database, including error handling and --local flag requirement.
